input.question: Would it take an obese person the same amount of time to die of starvation as a skinny person?
input.ground_truth: No. There is at least one case study of an obese person living for iirc 10 months on nothing but water and vitamin pills, with no adverse effects. In fact his health improved significantly on account of losing around a hundred kg. Meanwhile very skinny persons will die within weeks if not eating.

Question: Would it take an obese person the same amount of time to die of starvation as a skinny person?

Okay, let’s imagine you and your friend are both playing a game where you can’t eat for a long, long time.

If you are a little smaller (like a skinny person), your body doesn’t have as much stored up for energy, so you might feel hungry and weak faster.

If your friend is much bigger (like an obese person), their body has more stored up energy (like extra fat), so it takes much longer for them to run out of energy.

So, no, it wouldn’t take the same amount of time for an obese person and a skinny person to feel really, really weak or to die from not eating. The bigger person would take longer because they have more stored up.
